title: heimdal.consent.revoked payload (v1, contract-stub)
description: CONTRACT-STUB (Epic #3019 slice A4, #3041; FABLE_COMPANION §11#3, §6.4): schema-representable now, no runtime producer/consumer lands with this slice. The consent ledger runtime (A5) is out of scope here. Per §6.4, revocation does not unpublish already-published events (append-only, HEIM-1): it names the covered episodes so projections MUST suppress covered content going forward (suppression_state).

grant_ref.description: The grant_ref being revoked (matches a prior heimdal.consent.granted grant_ref).

covered_episode_ids.description: Episodes covered by this grant whose already-published content projections MUST suppress (§6.4). Append-only: the observation log itself is never rewritten.

reason.description: Optional free-text reason for the revocation.
